evidence.quote: With over 50 years of experience, Dinamic Oil, founded in 1970, is an Italian company specializing in the production of winches and planetary gearboxes. || Headquartered in Modena, Dinamic Oil has established itself on the international stage, with three production units, nine branches across Europe, America, and Asia, and an extensive network of distributors worldwide. || Application sectors Mobile Applications Marine Applications Mining & Drilling Applications Industrial Applications
